data_objects.name: hashed_id_feature_json
data_objects.meaning: Second representation of the same internal id set, with hash-like unique identifiers and AFT v4 features serialized as JSON.

variables.meaning: Continuous record score; most but not all id-matched values equal the first file's score.

variables.meaning: Valid JSON object containing miss_flag and numeric keys aft_v4_f0 through aft_v4_f44.

structure.description: Both files contain the same unique id values and can be joined one-to-one on id. Their uniq_id namespaces differ; the missingness-key name also differs inside feature_json.

uncertainties: The reason for the two identifier representations, the score differences on some matched ids, and the meanings of indexed AFT features are not supplied.
annotation_notes: Parse feature_json as JSON rather than using string splitting.
Use id, not uniq_id, to align the two files.
